name: Philips Hue
author: BaseCamp Linux
description: Control your Philips Hue lights from DisplayPad buttons
help: First pair your Hue Bridge in the plugin panel (press the bridge button, then click 'Pair'), then assign a Hue action to a DisplayPad button. Pick the light or group from the dropdown in the Button Actions window and the value is filled in for you; if you ever need to read or type one, the forms are 'Toggle light': light:ID or group:ID, for example group:1. 'Brightness': light:ID:PERCENT or group:ID:PERCENT, for example light:1:50, where 0 switches it off. 'Activate scene': GROUPID:SCENEID, where the scene id is the bridge's own, not the name you gave it in the Hue app. Entertainment groups are not listed: they belong to the sync software and do not appear in the Hue app either.
